facts.label: Project budget
facts.text: The project budget for Project Atlas is 48,000 euros.

facts.label: Project lead
facts.text: Mira Sommer is the project lead for Project Atlas.

facts.label: Project start
facts.text: The project start date is 1 March 2027.

facts.label: Pilot launch
facts.text: The pilot launch date is 15 June 2027.

facts.label: Annual leave
facts.text: Full-time employees receive 30 days of annual leave per calendar year.

facts.label: Leave requests
facts.text: Submit leave requests at least 10 working days before the first day of leave.

facts.label: Confirmation
facts.text: The people team confirms leave requests within 3 working days.

facts.label: Support hours
facts.text: Standard support is available Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00.

facts.label: Critical incidents
facts.text: The response time for critical incidents is 2 hours.

facts.label: Maintenance
facts.text: Scheduled maintenance takes place on the first Wednesday of each month from 18:00 to 19:00.
